title: Service
description: One treatment in src/data/services.json. The file is an object keyed by SKU.

sku.description: Unique code, also the key in services.json.

duration.description: Treatment time in minutes. The booking's end_time is start + duration.

cleanup.description: Buffer or cleanup time in minutes following the service. Blocks the next start but may run past closing time.

price_excl_vat.description: Derived from price_incl_vat and vat_rate when saved.

is_active.description: Inactive services are hidden from the booking page and cannot be booked.
